ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dw::Runtime var command = attributes.uriParams.command default "" --- try(() -> p("procesos." ++ command)) orElse ""

%dw 2.0 output application/java import * from dw::Runtime var procedure = payload.procedure default "" var queueKey = procedure match { case "Suspend" -> "suspend" case "Resume" -> "reconnect" case "Reconnect" -> "reconnect" case "Disconnect" -> "terminate" case "Terminate" -> "terminate" else -> "" } --- if (isEmpty(queueKey)) "" else (try(() -> p("azureStorage.collection.queue." ++ queueKey)) orElse "")

logger.doc:name: Log queue target
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "Enqueue procedure=" ++ ((vars.inputPayload.procedure default "") as String) ++ " queue=" ++ (vars.queueName default "")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "code": "202", "message": "The message has been saved in the queue", "x-correlation-id": attributes.headers."X-CORRELATION-ID" default attributes.headers."x-correlation-id" default vars.inputPayload.orderNumber }
